verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents first-party webhooks that send real-time push notifications to your application when account events occur. It also documents reliability semantics: a 200-acknowledgement requirement, stable event IDs for idempotent retry handling, delivery-status inspection and manual re-delivery. The Developer MCP can simulate events in the sandbox for testing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of endpoint registration and per-event-type subscription selection, signature verification details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
